main_text.p: nunciatur vel lętitiam & voluptatem, vel dolorem & triftitiam percipere debea-mus. Conciliandi quoq; hic minimè ra-tio negligenda, sed inftituenda ea : vel collaudatione amici, cuius in scribendo gratum nobis esse officium ostendemus ; vel gratiarum actione, & Collocatio & tractatio sententiarum.[ὑποσχέσει?] pollicita-tione similis officij: vel significatione ani-mi moderati & causæ,lætitiæ,aut triftitiæ ex re nunciata perceptæ. Collocatio talis erit,vt prima pars exordium cõstet: [ἐπαι-?]νῷ[?] laude & commendatione prudentiæ, humanitatis, suauitatis literarum amici. lib.2.epist.13.15.lib.7.epist.28. Aut [ἐπαναλή-?]ψει[?] repetitione breui eorum quæ ab ami-co scripta.li.9.epist.15.lib.11. epist.24. Aut gratiarum actione.lib.14. epist.8. Pars al-tera propositio [ἐπαίνου?] laudationem & [ἀποδοχῷ?] approbationem habebit eius quod nunciatur.lib.9. epist.5. Vel reprehensio-nem atque improbationem.lib. 2. epist.8. vel obtestationem. lib.8.epist.16.Pars ter-tia rationes complectetur,sumptas:à cau-sis.lib.2. epistola 8.lib.7.epistola 15.28.lib. 9. epistola 15. lib. 11. epistola 24. Aut ad-iunctis & circumstantiis: modi.lib.2.epi-stola 15.lib.14.epist. 8. Loci. lib.7.epist.28. Temporis ibid. Factorum. lib. 2. epist. 13.

page.notes: Greek words in the text (ὑποσχέσει, ἐπαινῶ, ἐπαναλήψει, ἐπαίνου, ἀποδοχῷ) are read from small and partly broken type and are doubtful; marked [?]. The first Greek word is hyphenated across the line end ("ἐπαι-" / "νῷ"). The margin note is set in small italic and its exact line breaks may differ. Faint marks at the left edge of the lines are edge show-through and were left out.
